_comment: Proposed answers for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge, derived from evidence in this repository. Only criteria backed by a file or setting are listed; everything else is left for the maintainers to answer. Format: https://github.com/ossf/best-practices-badge/blob/main/docs/bestpractices-json.md
contribution_justification: The contribution process, including pull requests, is described in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
dependency_monitoring_justification: Composer Audit checks the dependencies against known vulnerabilities in CI and fails the job on a finding, so a vulnerable dependency has to be upgraded or explicitly handled before a change passes: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/blob/main/.github/workflows/checks.yml (shared workflow: https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml).
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are public, searchable, addressable by URL and need no proprietary client: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/issues
floss_license_justification: Released under MIT, an OSI-approved licence: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/blob/main/LICENSE
license_location_justification: The licence is in the repository root: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/blob/main/LICENSE
repo_distributed_justification: The repository uses git, hosted at https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli
repo_public_justification: The source repository is public on GitHub: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli
repo_track_justification: Git records the author, date and change of every commit; the history is browsable at https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/commits/main
report_archive_justification: Public bug reports and the responses to them stay searchable in the issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported through the GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/issues
sites_https_justification: The repository and its download URLs are served over HTTPS by GitHub: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli
static_analysis_justification: PHPStan runs on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI where PHPStan is on by default (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml). Configuration: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/blob/main/Build/phpstan/phpstan.neon.
test_justification: The repository carries 4 PHPUnit test files under https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/tree/main/Tests. CI runs them on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI where unit tests are on by default (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml).
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Every pull request runs the test suite in GitHub Actions: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI where unit tests are on by default (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml).
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports go through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, which is enabled and described in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/blob/main/SECURITY.md: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The vulnerability reporting process is published in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-extension-scanner-cli/blob/main/SECURITY.md
